explanation: For integers E>0 and T>E, sensitivity Δ>0, ε>0 and 0<δ<1, put a=Δ/√v_FB. The sufficient condition a² ≤ (6E/(3E+2)) ε gives v_FB < v̄_(E,T) ≤ v_(E,T), with strict full-batch total-variance dominance for every S≥0. It is a sufficient domain, not a classification outside it or an ordering of every pair of smaller batches. The target bindings cover the transcript conclusions and full-batch reference; the average-only strengthening remains conventional exposition in the supplied assessments.
purpose: Start with the usable positive result.
